//: One entry per screen to compare: storyboard artboard (390x844) vs the real app route rendered with a scenario (preview/scenarios/<scenario>.ts). Edit freely: route, scenario, notes and steps (Playwright actions run before the screenshot: fill/click/press/wait/waitFor/scroll). See preview/README.md.

screens.title: 1.1 Welcome and sign-in
screens.notes: Welcome and sign-in in one screen, (auth)/index (the separate /sign-in screen is gone). Sign in with Apple shows because the preview reports Platform.OS ios to app code. The storyboard clips its legal line at 844 px; the app scrolls.

screens.title: 1.2 About you
screens.notes: Step 1 of 6: first name, date of birth and the Terms (the storyboard has no Terms tick; DESIGN §3.1 step 3 keeps an explicit one). Steps type the storyboard's answers with the preview's viewer name.

screens.title: 1.3 Your area
screens.notes: Step 2 of 6, where completeOnboarding runs. Steps type 8000: the card shows Aarhus C. Its status badge comes from the bundled areas.json (Aarhus is on the waitlist there, so "Aarhus opens soon" where the storyboard says "Aarhus is live"); the area doc is only readable after onboarding.

screens.title: 1.4 Consent for sensitive interests (once)
screens.notes: Step 3 of 6. Consent copy is hash-locked in packages/core (art9-blanket-*): match the look, not the storyboard wording.

screens.title: 1.5 Interests
screens.notes: Step 4 of 6. Steps type "brætspilsaften" and tap Add; the scenario answers with the suggestion "brætspil" ("Did you mean ...?"). Area chips (Popular in Aarhus) come from areas/aarhus.

screens.title: 1.6 Who you'd like to meet
screens.notes: Step 5 of 6. Prefs: ages 28–42, 10 km, Dansk + English, weekday evenings + Saturday/Sunday daytime.

screens.title: 1.7 Photo, about me, notifications, pledge
screens.notes: Step 6 of 6: photo, About me (typed in the user's language by the scenario), notifications and the safety pledge; Finish ends onboarding (Home is then the waitlist while the city is not live).

screens.title: 1.8 Your city's waitlist (until it opens)
screens.notes: Home tab while the area is not live (WaitlistScreen): Odense, 186 of 250.

screens.title: 2.1 This week, before the drop
screens.notes: Home tab, Tuesday of week 46 before the drop. Interests include one private ("gravid"), which must not appear in "What we'll match on". One active pod (sourdough, Sat 14:00, bakery café, Frederiksbjerg) and an archived one.

screens.title: 2.2 The drop: a pod proposal
screens.notes: Home tab right after the drop: brætspil proposal, not answered.

screens.title: 2.3 Why this pod
screens.notes: Modal sheet over the home tab. Server reason codes only.

screens.title: 2.4 Waiting for the others
screens.notes: The storyboard is the home tab ("This week" active, "Your weekly drop") after saying yes: 3 of 5, 4 needed. The same state on the pod route is app-pod-waiting.

screens.title: 2.5 No pod this week
screens.notes: Home tab, no pod this week, reason NO_THEME_BUCKET (names no setting). The 3-weeks variant that names a setting is app-home-none-setting.

screens.title: 3.1 Pod confirmed
screens.notes: Pod screen right after confirmation, planning, no options yet. Storyboard shows the tab bar with Pods active and a back arrow.

screens.title: 3.2 Plan the meetup
screens.notes: Monday 16 Nov, voting closes Tuesday 17 Nov 18:00 (72 h after the pod was confirmed at Saturday's answer deadline; see WEEK46 in scenarios/_pod.ts). Two options: Sat 21 Nov 14:00 (3 yes: Mette, Jonas, you) and Sun 22 Nov 11:00 (2 yes, you have not voted). One spot left. The storyboard's "Saturday 15 Nov" comes before both deadlines.

screens.title: 3.3 Suggest a time and a public place
screens.notes: "Suggest a time" opens from the planner's "Suggest another time". Steps pick Sunday 22 Nov at 15:00 from the Day and Time sheets (the storyboard's Sunday, after the planning window: see WEEK46 in scenarios/_pod.ts), type "café latin" in the place search, pick the first placeholder place so it shows selected, and focus the search again (the storyboard draws it focused). Place search goes to the scenario's places, named in the preview's language (Google Places is stubbed on the network).

screens.title: 3.4 Pod page: next step, plan, chat, members
screens.notes: Friday 19:30, meetup Saturday 14:00: "Still coming?" pending, chat open (3 messages), Sofie hasn't confirmed.

screens.title: 3.5 Meetup chat (24 h before to 24 h after)
screens.notes: Saturday 13:58, five messages (two from today). Messages expire 72 h after the meetup.

screens.title: 4.1 How did it go? (push the next morning)
screens.notes: Sunday 10:05, the morning after. Steps answer the storyboard's state: meet Mette and Jonas again, rating 4. "Meet again" is Yes / No per person (DESIGN §3.6: yes, no or no answer), where the storyboard draws one checkbox.

screens.title: 4.2 Member: block or report
screens.notes: Member sheet for Jonas (block or report): a bottom sheet over the dimmed backdrop. The meetup chat is still open, so the pod counts as active and Block says Jonas is taken out.

screens.title: 4.3 Report
screens.notes: Report Jonas (user report). Steps pick "I felt unsafe" as on the storyboard. The message-report variant is app-sheets-report-message.

screens.title: 5.1 A pod about a private interest
screens.notes: Home tab, week 48: proposal about the private interest "gravid" (no age span, no shared interests by schema).

screens.title: 5.2 Interests and private interests
screens.notes: Interests tab: 4 interests + private "gravid" (consent given 4 Nov 2026), 5 of 20.

screens.title: 5.3 Privacy settings
screens.notes: Me → Privacy. 1 private interest with consent, same-gender off, photo shown to confirmed pods, 1 blocked person, no export in progress. Opened directly, so there is no back chevron (on a phone it shows above "Me").

screens.title: 5.4 Delete account
screens.notes: Delete account. Provider is Apple (re-auth before deletion). "Sign in again and delete" asks once more (native alert), then re-authenticates.

screens.title: Email link sign-in
screens.notes: From "Continue with email" on Main. No storyboard; laid out like the onboarding steps.

screens.title: Email link sign-in: link sent
screens.notes: Steps type an address and send; the fake Auth accepts it.

screens.title: Email link landing
screens.notes: Without a link in the URL: the progress state.

screens.title: Email link landing: confirm the address
screens.notes: A valid link opened on a phone that has no pending address stored: the person types the address.

screens.title: Email link landing: link does not work
screens.notes: A pending address is stored but the link has no code: the dead-end state with "Back to the start".

screens.title: Onboarding step 1: nothing typed yet
screens.notes: The first state of "About you": empty fields, Terms unticked, Continue disabled. (The old /terms, /dob, /name, /photo, /notifications, /pledge and /done routes are folded into the six steps.)

screens.title: Onboarding step 2: "Where did you hear about Grouper?"
screens.notes: Below the area card: the optional source question (DESIGN §3.1 step 6, F37), scrolled into view with one answer picked.

screens.title: Onboarding step 5: same-gender pods consent sheet
screens.notes: Turning on "Same-gender pods only" opens the gender picker with its own unticked consent (PRIVACY.md §3.6), verbatim from core.

screens.title: Home: no pod, names the setting
screens.notes: Reason RADIUS (third week with the same cause): names the distance setting.

screens.title: Pod route: proposal (not a member yet)
Plan route after the plan locked
screens.notes: "Your meetup": voting closed and the Saturday option won with 3 yes votes; the plan with map, safety and calendar; the viewer's answer and who else is coming.

screens.title: Pod route in the extra voting round ("No time works yet")
screens.notes: No option had 3 yes votes at Tuesday's deadline: one extra 24 h round until Wednesday 18:00 (D7; the planning sticky note).

screens.title: Planner in the extra voting round
screens.notes: Two options with 2 yes each, the viewer said no to both; one spot left for another option.

screens.title: Confirmed pod about a private interest (photos hidden)
screens.notes: The privacy sticky note: photos stay hidden in those pods until each person chooses to show theirs (S6). Only Line has; the viewer's "Show my photo to this pod" is off.

screens.title: Chat: a phone number before the meetup ("You haven't met yet")
screens.notes: The storyboard's warning state (pod-chat.dc.html showWarning): sendMessage answers with CONTACT_INFO_BEFORE_MEETUP for contact details before the meetup (the scenario's callable), so nothing is posted until "Send anyway".

screens.title: Block Jonas: the confirmation in the member sheet
screens.notes: After "Block Jonas": take him out (default) or leave the pod yourself, then Block or Cancel.

screens.title: Pods tab
screens.notes: One active (sourdough), one past (climbing).

screens.notes: One blocked person (Rasmus).
